question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**most**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the** deltaic regions of India.**
 
• In the first filler '**most**' should be used because it means **the majority of; nearly all of. **(अधिकांश; लगभग सभी)
 
 
• *Example: **Most** of our buses are running at 20-minute intervals.*
 
 
 
• The sentence expresses the fact that the majority of the eastern coastal plain is considerably wider than the plain on the western coast.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passage:__*** The predominantly deltaic eastern coastal plain is an area of deep sedimentation. Over __**most**__ **(1)** of its length it is considerably wider (2) ________ the plain on the western coast. (3)________ major deltas, from south to north, (4) _______ of the Kaveri, the Krishna-Godavari, the Mahanadi, and the Ganges-Brahmaputra rivers. The last of (5)________ is some 190 miles (300 km) wide, but only about one-third of it lies within India.*
